name: form-worker
description: Free, self-hosted form backend for your websites on Cloudflare Workers: email notifications, built-in spam filtering and an admin dashboard. Built for freelancers and small agencies.
author: Akshit Savaliya

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

SMTP_USER.description: SMTP username. For Gmail, the full address that will send notifications.

SMTP_PASS.description: SMTP password. For Gmail, create an [App Password](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/185833) (needs 2-Step Verification); your normal password will not work.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the dashboard at `/admin` (any username). Use a long random value, e.g. from `openssl rand -base64 24`.

MAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Sender name shown on notification emails.

DB.description: D1 database for forms and entries. Created automatically.
